_predictions.world_gdp: The four runs end at 0.60-0.85x vanilla's median, most below 0.80 (the book is cold, not run 1's seed alone); Britain's stall is the least certain part (its tax path is political, seed-dependent).
_predictions.u_star: The leaders' U* at 1913 well above vanilla's and above the register's aims (USA 25%, Britain 10%) in at least three of four runs.
_predictions.prices: Coal and iron above vanilla's in GBP in every run over 1880-1915.
_predictions.play_time: Recorded, not graded (§10.123); x0.90-1.05 of vanilla 1.15.2 over the century.
